author: Contributor 90
about: GitHub's published examples (the response examples of its REST description, spec/openapi.json.gz) for the operations the github pack serves, replayed in one story: The Octocat signs up, makes the github organization and its Hello-World repository, and works in it as GitHub's reference pages show: a team, a push, contents and the git database, an issue on a milestone with Mona Lisa's comment, a pull request she reviews and the Octocat merges, a status, a release and its asset, a deploy key, a ruleset, the production environment with its branch policies and secret, a variable, a CI run and its artifact, a GitHub App registered from its manifest and installed, and two security advisories. Each setup step makes an example's precondition true or reads its effect; each exampleDiffers names why the World's answer differs from the published one, and each example no World of this pack replays is in notReplayed with why. spec/doc-examples.json also holds the documentation’s stated rules and published option examples, each replayed with its effect asserted.

notReplayed.issues/get#200 pinned_comment: Pinning a comment is a separate management flow (issues/pin-comment, or GraphQL pinIssueComment) neither the demand nor the customer life uses. Those write operations answer the gap; the replay account has no pinned comment. https://docs.github.com/en/rest/issues/comments#pin-an-issue-comment
